Harry Bush is an English cricketer born on November 22, 1989, in Ashford, Kent, England. He is a right-handed batsman and has played primarily as a batsman. Bush is known for his involvement in first-class and List A cricket.

He played for Sussex County Cricket Club. His role in the team was generally that of a batsman, and he has participated in county cricket competitions in England. Throughout his career, Bush has contributed with the bat and occasionally performed in the field.
